mutations.name: a snapshot exactly at the threshold gates
kills: the merge decision under visual threshold mode on merges a snapshot measured exactly at the threshold with the visual check green, saying what it measured

mutations.name: a removed snapshot does not gate under on
kills: the merge decision under visual threshold mode on gates a removed snapshot, even where the seat's globs do not match it

mutations.name: the decision ignores the recorded mode, so shadow decides as on
kills: the merge decision without visual threshold mode on keeps today's decision under shadow for a snapshot measured at 0.004

mutations.name: an unmeasured snapshot does not gate under on
kills: the merge decision under visual threshold mode on gates an unmeasured snapshot, naming why it could not be measured

mutations.name: public API, token and harness paths do not gate under on
kills: the merge decision under visual threshold mode on gates a public API change that no seat glob matches
